subject: zoology_2
question_text: Distinguish between the enzymes renin and rennin.

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.49, VSAQ 72. page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Excretory Products and their Elimination · 2 marks

steps.label: Where each is made
steps.why: They come from two different organs and do two unrelated jobs; only the spelling is close.
common_mistakes: Swapping the two. Renin is from the kidney, rennin from the stomach.
Writing that both are digestive enzymes. Renin is not.
steps.memory_tip: Renin — renal, the kidney. Rennin — has a second n, and works on milk.
steps.margin_note: Write it as a two-row comparison.
lines: Renin is produced in the kidney.
Rennin is produced in the stomach.

steps.label: What each acts on
steps.why: Renin starts a chain that raises blood pressure, while rennin curdles the milk an infant drinks.
common_mistakes: Saying renin digests protein. It acts on angiotensinogen.
Giving only the sources without the actions.
steps.memory_tip: Renin raises pressure; rennin curdles milk.
steps.margin_note: One line each keeps the contrast clear.

lines.text: Rennin converts casein into calcium paracaseinate

insider_note: The two names differ by one letter, so write them well apart on the page and give the organ beside each.
